Synopsis:
No defeats! Futanari demons all happy with tentacle torture!

Something strange is happening at the beach house on the island inhabited by futanari oni!?
When the red and blue oni notice that the taste of the takoyaki has changed and go to investigate, they find that an unfamiliar sea god has become the owner of the beach house!
The sea god, delighted by the islanders' visit, transforms seawater into tentacles to "entertain" them...!
